text: 下面进入大作文 02 · 科技与现代生活：智能手机依赖与真实陪伴，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 神态动作挂载】用 staring blankly 挂载描摹全员低头看手机，并顺手引出主题：
The satirical cartoon vividly depicts a family sitting around a dinner table, yet everyone is staring blankly at a smartphone screen instead of talking warmly.
手术刀点拨：satirical 替换生僻词，staring blankly at 直接从《大作文终极手册》神态库拿来用。
【二段正面 · 科技便利】先承认科技的好处，不要写 technology lets people get news easily。请用 has made it remarkably convenient：
Digital innovations have made it remarkably convenient for people to access vast information and handle daily tasks efficiently.
手术刀点拨：形式宾语 it 紧跟动词 made，后置不定式短语，重心稳健。
【二段转折 + 尾段主仆倒装】批判“只靠屏幕找快乐远远不明智，人们没意识到情感代价”，结尾用 Only by... can we：

Relying solely on virtual screens for happiness is far from wise, as countless individuals fail to realize the emotional cost. Only by treating smartphones as helpful tools rather than letting them dominate our lives can we preserve true warmth.
手术刀点拨：far from wise + fail to 双含蓄否定，cannot attach too much importance to 与 Only by 形成尾段双保险。
